name: BP — Classify Leads (تصنيف العملاء)
description: يقرأ Sales Pipeline، يستخرج البريد والجوال من حقل Notes، ويصنّف كل سجل: عميل محتمل / باحث عن عمل / تحميل محتوى / مورّد / اختبار داخلي. فقط «عميل محتمل» يُعلَّم Nurture Safe. لا يرسل شيئاً ولا يغيّر المرحلة.

parameters.content:
## Sales Pipeline — Classify Leads

The pipeline mixes real buyers, job seekers from the careers pages, magazine downloads, suppliers, and the owner own test submissions. One nurture sequence across all of them would pitch services to job applicants.

This reads every row, lifts Email and Phone out of the free-text Notes, and tags Lead Type. **Only rows tagged عميل محتمل get Nurture Safe = true.** Anything ambiguous stays غير مصنّف for a human to decide.

It writes five fields and never touches Stage, and it sends nothing to anyone.

Runs daily at 02:00 so rows created by the website are classified before anyone acts on them.
